sources.method: author-provided library; no public download command exists (ADR 0006)

notes: Author-provided artefact (ADR 0006): the HeteroGNN library is dormant — no canonical workflow consumes it directly (the Stage 1 workflows consume the author HG drug-embedding table produced by it). There is no public download and no recorded upstream commit, so version is explicitly "unknown". `source/AGENTS.md` (the library's file-content index) was a tracked file before the restructure and moved with the library; it is included in the source/ count. The count includes 10 regenerable `__pycache__/*.pyc` files under source/src/__pycache__/ (gitignored; ticket 10 removes all __pycache__). Split from the old lowercase `hg/` directory in ticket 05 (spec §5); only the feature_extract/ and models/ asset trees of the sibling KPGT item are gitignored, so HG code stays tracked.
